name: time_duration
notes: month/year use the repo convention (mean Gregorian); raw text kept

name: temp_unspecified
notes: location not stated in source (never promoted to core/surface)

name: temp_trajectory
notes: T(t) series; location must be stated

name: temp_rate
notes: heating/cooling rate (a temperature DIFFERENCE per time)

name: ph
notes: 0-14 bounds; never defaulted to 7; mixture pH never averaged

name: titratable_acidity
notes: expressed as an acid equivalent; acid must be named

name: moisture_content
notes: basis (wet/dry) mandatory; wet-basis <=1, dry-basis may exceed 1

name: oxygen_headspace
notes: absent is UNKNOWN not 0; atmosphere composition may be qualitative

name: pressure
notes: gauge vs absolute must be stated; bare psi/bar is AMBIGUOUS

name: microwave_power
notes: nominal oven power, not absorbed power

name: surface_area_volume_proxy
notes: only if stated or computable from stated geometry
